Fixed Indemnity
Plan Options
WB ChoiceWB Select
Two plan options that pay set cash benefits for everyday care, hospital
stays and surgery — with no deductible and no coinsurance.
IMPORTANT: These are scheduled fixed indemnity options under the Wellness Brands Health Plan. They are not comprehensive major
medical insurance and are not minimum essential coverage. On a large claim, the balance above the scheduled benefit is yours. This guide
is a plain-language summary and does not replace the Summary Plan Description, which governs in all cases.

WB Choice & WB Select
Both options pay a set cash amount for each covered event —
a fixed amount per hospital day, per office visit, and per
surgery by tier. There is no deductible to satisfy and no
coinsurance to calculate, so you know what the plan pays
before you receive care.
Choice is the lower-contribution option. Select pays higher
amounts across the board, covers more office visits, and
triples the emergency room limit. Both use the First Health
Network and both include Healthcare Ninja advocacy at no
additional cost.
Included on both options
A 30-day free look from your effective date.
Review your benefits and cancel within 30
days for a full refund of contributions, offset
by any claims paid on your behalf.
Contributions vary by plan option and coverage tier. They are quoted separately in your enrollment materials and are not shown in this guide.

goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 4
How the Plans Work
Scheduled Benefits
Each benefit carries its own dollar amount and its own limit, paid in cash when a
covered event happens. The plan pays that amount regardless of what the
provider charges, and regardless of any other coverage you have. You pay a set
visit fee to the provider at the time of service, and the plan then pays its visit
benefit. On a primary care visit, that is a $60 fee and up to $100 on Choice, a
$50 fee and up to $150 on Select. Specialist and urgent care work the same
way at their own amounts, shown in the benefits table. Visits beyond the annual
count are yours in full.
Preventive Care
Preventive services are paid at fixed amounts set by Schedule A on page 6, the
same on both options. Schedule A lists 26 covered services, each with its own
frequency and benefit amount, from routine screenings to immunizations. Each
amount is a cap, not a floor, and the benefit is payable in-network only.
Waiting Periods
A 30-day waiting period applies to sickness. Coverage for accidents begins
immediately on your effective date. Limits stated per calendar year reset each
January 1.
Pre-Existing Conditions
A 12-month / 12-month limitation applies to hospital and surgery benefits only.
Those benefits are not payable during the first 12 months of coverage for a
condition you received medical advice, diagnosis, care, or treatment for in the 12
months before your effective date. Your other benefits remain available subject
to the plan's terms.
Example: a knee
condition
You enroll effective March 1 and you were treated for a knee condition in the
preceding 12 months. Hospital and surgery benefits for that knee condition are
unavailable until March 1 of the following year. Office visits, the preventive
benefit, and your other benefits are unaffected.
IMPORTANT: These are scheduled fixed indemnity options and are not minimum essential coverage. Benefits are capped per benefit; any charge above
a scheduled benefit amount is yours.

Network Advantages
Your Plan uses the First Health Network, a national PPO
maintained by First Health, a CVS Health company.
National PPO
A nationwide network of
contracted doctors, hospitals
and facilities.
Discounted charges
Where a discount applies it
reduces the provider's charge,
which reduces your balance.
No referrals
No preauthorization or
referral is required for any
covered service.
Which benefits require the network
BENEFITNETWORK REQUIREMENT
Primary care, specialist and urgent care visitsIn-network only
Preventive & wellness benefitIn-network only
Inpatient hospital benefitPayable at any hospital
Surgical benefit, all tiersPayable at any facility, any provider
Emergency room benefitNot network-restricted
What the network is — and is not
First Health is a network only. It is not an insurer and not a claims payor, it does not guarantee any discount, and a
network discount does not increase the amount the Plan pays. If you use an out-of-network provider for a benefit that
requires the network, no benefit is payable and you owe 100% of the charge.
First Health is an independent company and is not the insurer or claims payor for this Plan. You may still owe the provider the balance of the charge
after the Plan's scheduled benefit is paid.

goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 8
Provider Lookup
Confirm that a provider participates in the First Health Network before you receive care.
01Go to firsthealthlbp.com
No access code is needed. Search for doctors, hospitals, specialists and facilities near you.
02Or call First Health at (800) 226-5116
Ask whether a specific provider is participating before your appointment.
Why it matters
Office visits and the preventive & wellness benefit are
payable in-network only. Out-of-network care under those
benefits pays nothing and you owe the full charge. Hospital,
surgery and emergency room benefits are payable
regardless of network status.
The directory address and the network phone number are also printed on your member ID card. Network participation changes over time; confirm
before each episode of care.

goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 9
Services Included with Every Plan
Beyond the insured benefits, both options come bundled with member services at no additional cost
to you.
Healthcare Ninja (HCN)
Your personal healthcare advocate
Healthcare Ninja is the patient advocacy service for the Wellness
Brands Health Plan. HCN supports you and your eligible family
members across a wide range of healthcare issues — helping you
save on out-of-pocket expenses, find doctors, and compare facilities,
providers and prescription costs.
Bill review and negotiation
HCN reviews and negotiates medical bills to reduce the
balance left after your scheduled benefits are paid.
Finding low-cost care
Search and compare facilities, providers and prescription
costs before you commit to care.
Family coverage
Advocacy extends to your eligible family members at no
additional cost.
$10,000 group term life
Included for the primary member only, under a separate
group term life policy.
Kindly Human
24/7 peer support
Kindly Human's service is pre-clinical and based on humanistic needs to find support through every individual's natural
need for meaningful connection. Members can connect 24/7 with Peers who share their cultural and social context and
have experienced something similar to what they are facing.
What you authorize when you enroll
By enrolling, you designate HCN as your agent and representative for advocacy purposes — including receiving your
personal health information, reviewing your medical and billing records, and negotiating and resolving your medical
invoices — and you authorize Wellness Brands Management LLC and its third-party administrator to share your claim-
related health information with HCN.
Healthcare Ninja is a benefits advocacy service — it is not insurance and is not affiliated with or serviced by any insurance carrier. Savings examples are
illustrative and are not guaranteed; outcomes vary case by case, and you remain personally responsible for your own medical bills. Group term life is
provided under a separate group term life insurance policy and takes effect only once the Plan Sponsor executes the applicable written rider and the
insurance coverage becomes effective; the rider and the policy control eligibility, beneficiary rules, exclusions, and claims procedures.

This is a summary of what is not covered. For complete details, refer to the Summary Plan Description.
NOT COVERED ON EITHER OPTIONALSO EXCLUDED OR LIMITED

TelemedicineOut-of-network office visits and preventive services

Outpatient diagnostics and advanced radiologyAny charge above a scheduled benefit amount
Skilled nursing and home health careEmergency room visits beyond the annual limit
Physical and occupational therapyOffice visits beyond the annual visit count

Also not covered: services that are not medically necessary, experimental or investigational treatment, cosmetic procedures, dental
and vision care, hearing aids, infertility treatment, custodial care, alternative medicine, weight-loss treatment, work-related injuries
covered by workers' compensation, and non-emergency care outside the United States.
Important disclosures
IMPORTANT: These are scheduled fixed indemnity options under the
Wellness Brands Health Plan, designed and operated as excepted-
benefit coverage. They are not comprehensive major medical insurance
and are not minimum essential coverage, and may leave significant out-
of-pocket costs on large claims.
This is a supplement to health insurance and is not a substitute for
major medical coverage. Lack of major medical coverage or other
minimum essential coverage may result in an additional payment with
your taxes in some states.
The federal No Surprises Act does not apply to this Plan. Providers may
bill you for amounts above the benefit paid by the Plan, except where
state law provides otherwise.
Benefit amounts, options, and availability are subject to change and to
eligibility, covered services, and exclusions. The Summary Plan
Description governs in all cases and controls if there is any conflict.
Benefits not expressly listed in this guide are not covered. No benefit
is payable under either option unless it is listed or added by signed
Plan amendment.

goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 12
Eligibility, Enrollment & Key Terms
You may enroll once the Plan Administrator confirms you meet the
Plan's eligibility rules — either as an employee of the Plan Sponsor
or a participating employer, or as a Working Owner who satisfies
Section 3.8 of the Summary Plan Description. Eligible dependents
are your legal spouse and children through the end of the month in
which they turn 26. Coverage tiers are Member Only, Member +
Spouse, Member + Child(ren), and Member + Family.
30-day free look
You have 30 days from your effective date to
review your benefits and cancel for a full
refund of contributions, offset by any claims
paid on your behalf.
What you contribute. Contributions are not shown in this guide. Your monthly contribution is quoted separately in your enrollment
materials and depends on the option you choose and your coverage tier. Contributions are due on the first of the month, and a 31-
day grace period applies to a late payment.
TERMWHAT IT MEANS
Scheduled benefit
A set cash amount the plan pays for a specific covered service, regardless of the total bill.
Fixed indemnity
A plan that pays fixed cash amounts per event rather than a percentage of the bill.
Surgical tier
The category, Tier 1 through Tier 7, that sets the scheduled benefit for a given procedure,
determined by CPT code.
Per benefit maximum
The most the plan will pay for a given benefit. These options cap most benefits this way rather
than with one annual maximum.
Visit Fee
An amount you pay the provider at the time of a covered office, specialist, or urgent-care visit. It
is separate from, and not reimbursed by, the plan's scheduled benefit for that visit.
12/12 pre-existing exclusion
Hospital and surgery benefits for a pre-existing condition are excluded for the first 12 months
of coverage, based on care received in the 12 months before coverage began.
Coverage tier
Who is covered: Member Only, Member + Spouse, Member + Child(ren), or Member + Family.
First Health Network
The national PPO used by the Plan. Office visits and the preventive benefit are payable in-
network only.
Healthcare Ninja (HCN)
The patient advocacy service included with every plan. HCN helps you find low-cost
care, review and negotiate medical bills, and reduce the balance left after the plan pays.
Not insurance.

goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 14
Company Information
Who does what
Wellness Brands Management LLC sponsors the Plan and is the general partner of
Good Life Partners, LP, the partnership you join as a Limited Partner. Merchants Benefit
Administration (MBA) is the Plan Administrator and processes claims and eligibility.
Neo Insurance Solutions handles billing and enrollment. First Health is the provider
network. Healthcare Ninja (HCN) is the member advocacy service.
About Wellness
Brands
Wellness Brands Management LLC sponsors the Wellness Brands Health Plan
and designs its benefit options, which are operated as excepted-benefit coverage
for members who want predictable, affordable coverage for everyday care and
surgical events.
About Neo
Insurance
Solutions
Neo Insurance Solutions is a full service health insurance provider specializing in
product development through partnerships with national carriers and distribution
through multiple agent channels. Neo Insurance Solutions, LLC and Neo Insurance
Advisors, DBA, Neo Insurance Agents are related companies under common ownership.
Plan administration
Merchants Benefit Administration is the Plan Administrator and processes claims and
eligibility. Neo Insurance Solutions is the billing administrator. The group term life
benefit is provided under a separate group term life insurance policy.
This guide is a plain-language summary for general information only. The Summary Plan Description governs in all cases and controls if there is any
conflict. First Health and Healthcare Ninja are independent companies. Healthcare Ninja is not insurance.

Review your benefits and cancel within 30
days for a full refund of contributions, offset
by any claims paid on your behalf. Contributions vary by plan option and coverage tier. They are quoted separately in your enrollment materials and are not shown in this guide. goodlifepartnersScheduled Fixed Indemnity Plans | Page 4
How the Plans Work
Scheduled Benefits
Each benefit carries its own dollar amount and its own limit, paid in cash when a
covered event happens. The plan pays that amount regardless of what the
provider charges, and regardless of any other coverage you have. You pay a set
visit fee to the provider at the time of service, and the plan then pays its visit
benefit. On a primary care visit, that is a $60 fee and up to $100 on Choice, a
$50 fee and up to $150 on Select. Specialist and urgent care work the same
way at their own amounts, shown in the benefits table. Visits beyond the annual
count are yours in full. Preventive Care
Preventive services are paid at fixed amounts set by Schedule A on page 6, the
same on both options. Schedule A lists 26 covered services, each with its own
frequency and benefit amount, from routine screenings to immunizations. Each
amount is a cap, not a floor, and the benefit is payable in-network only. Waiting Periods
A 30-day waiting period applies to sickness. Coverage for accidents begins
immediately on your effective date. Limits stated per calendar year reset each
January 1. Pre-Existing Conditions
A 12-month / 12-month limitation applies to hospital and surgery benefits only. Those benefits are not payable during the first 12 months of coverage for a
condition you received medical advice, diagnosis, care, or treatment for in the 12
months before your effective date. Your other benefits remain available subject
to the plan's terms. Example: a knee
condition
You enroll effective March 1 and you were treated for a knee condition in the
preceding 12 months. Hospital and surgery benefits for that knee condition are
unavailable until March 1 of the following year. Office visits, the preventive
benefit, and your other benefits are unaffected.

Eligibility, Enrollment & Key Terms
You may enroll once the Plan Administrator confirms you meet the
Plan's eligibility rules — either as an employee of the Plan Sponsor
or a participating employer, or as a Working Owner who satisfies
Section 3.8 of the Summary Plan Description. Eligible dependents
are your legal spouse and children through the end of the month in
which they turn 26. Coverage tiers are Member Only, Member +
Spouse, Member + Child(ren), and Member + Family. 30-day free look
You have 30 days from your effective date to
review your benefits and cancel for a full
refund of contributions, offset by any claims
paid on your behalf. What you contribute. Contributions are not shown in this guide. Your monthly contribution is quoted separately in your enrollment
materials and depends on the option you choose and your coverage tier. Contributions are due on the first of the month, and a 31-
day grace period applies to a late payment. TERMWHAT IT MEANS
Scheduled benefit
A set cash amount the plan pays for a specific covered service, regardless of the total bill. Fixed indemnity
A plan that pays fixed cash amounts per event rather than a percentage of the bill. Surgical tier
The category, Tier 1 through Tier 7, that sets the scheduled benefit for a given procedure,
determined by CPT code. Per benefit maximum
The most the plan will pay for a given benefit. These options cap most benefits this way rather
than with one annual maximum. Visit Fee
An amount you pay the provider at the time of a covered office, specialist, or urgent-care visit. It
is separate from, and not reimbursed by, the plan's scheduled benefit for that visit. 12/12 pre-existing exclusion
Hospital and surgery benefits for a pre-existing condition are excluded for the first 12 months
of coverage, based on care received in the 12 months before coverage began. Coverage tier
Who is covered: Member Only, Member + Spouse, Member + Child(ren), or Member + Family. First Health Network
The national PPO used by the Plan. Office visits and the preventive benefit are payable in-
network only.
